description: Localized display labels for BGM tracks (mostly BGM_* ids with 'Track NN' text). Bgm rows reference these ids through Id_SoundText for the sound collection UI and free-battle BGM selector.

ID.simple: BGM label text id (row key), e.g. BGM_MENU, BGM_BATTLE_01.
ID.technical: FName ID of FGameDataTableRow_GameText. FGameDataTableRow_Bgm::Id_SoundText stores this id; UGameCollectionSoundListItem::GetTitleTextId returns it for the collection sound item, and the free-battle rule screen adds Row->Id_SoundText.ToString() as an option with SetUseTextId(true) so options resolve through the text manager. The table is loaded as SoundTextDataTable_<Language> in slot 12 of the 14-table GameText array. Playback ids such as PlayBgm(FName("BGM_MENU")) use the same strings, but playback itself is handled by the sound manager/Bgm table, not by this text table.

Text.simple: The localized BGM track label shown in lists/option boxes.
Text.technical: FString row text (+0x10), resolved through GetText by any text block or option box using the id, with the normal FormatText substitution rules. Companion exports contain 28 rows per language, all nonempty; En values are 'Track 01'..'Track 28' in id order. Locked sound-collection entries substitute a different system text id (SYS_STORY_CORRELATION_DIAGRAM_LABEL_1003) instead of reading this text. The Bgm row's CueSheetName/Duration control actual audio and are unrelated to this field.

notes: FGameDataTableRow_GameText with 11 exported language variants (28 identical ids each in the companion export). Slot 12 of the 14-table array; Config/DefaultGame.ini:35-45 assigns each language variant to its chunk.

The same BGM_* string is used in three roles: Bgm table row name / sound playback id (GameSoundManager::PlayBgm), Bgm.Id_SoundText pointing into this table, and this table's own row key. Only the second/third are text lookups; a PlayBgm call does not read SoundTextDataTable.
No prefix-specific dispatch: GetText resolves any non-SYS_ id across the combined 14-table array. Since BGM_* ids are distinctive, collisions are unlikely but not prevented by code.

Reconstruction caveat: FindTextRow/Tick are behaviour-certified rather than byte-identical (status/functions.json 0x14af290, 0x14c96f0; BEHAV BG03). Partial Content; no claim about all retail or Blueprint-only consumers.

usages.detail: Returns BgmRow->Id_SoundText as the title text id for a sound-collection item.
Applies the item's title id (or a locked placeholder system id) to the collection sound item's text block.
Adds every battle Bgm row's Id_SoundText string as a BGM option and enables text-id resolution on the option box.
Loads SoundTextDataTable_<Language> into the shared GameText table array.
